ends.note: the unnamed 9th-8th alley east of Linn (printed ALLEY) is closed at x ~3250 behind 735 W 9th; a narrower strip (lines y ~3436/3455) continues east to about x 3530

notes: Pennock Alley and Cedar Alley have their names printed across Linn (PENNOCK ... ALLEY, CEDAR ... ALLEY), so the parts east of Linn are the same alleys; both run on to the east sheet edge. At Baymiller each alley jogs: Pennock's west arm (sheet 50 side, lines y 1527/1571) is about 33 px south of its east arm (lines 1484/1547); Cedar's west arm (2506/2545) is about 11 px south of its east arm (2496/2532). The Baymiller points sit midway between the arms. Pennock is printed 20' near Baymiller and 10' near the east edge (20 recorded). The unnamed 9th-8th alley (west of Linn no name; east of Linn printed only ALLEY) crosses Baymiller and Linn, recorded with '' as its name and also given in 'alleys'. It drifts from y ~3419 at Baymiller to ~3445 at Linn. Hand Street (printed HAND on the key map, not on this sheet; about 20 ft, lines x 2942/3011) and Rittenhouse Street (printed RITTENHOUSE, lines x 3475/3655) enter West Court from the north only. Kossuth, next to the east, is off the sheet. No N-S street at the east edge (the drawn area stops at x ~3855; sheet 52 continues).
